newsitem.title: USA: Pa. House votes to end property taxes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pa. House votes to end property taxes - paper.

text.p: Pennsylvania's House of Representatives voted to end property taxes within one year and develop other school funding mechanisms, but prospects for the bill in the Senate look dim, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Thursday.
The original version of the proposed legislation would have only allowed local governments to levy income taxes to reduce reliance on property taxes.
But an amendment to the bill gutted that language and introduced a one-year deadline on the property tax system.
Senate President Pro Tempore Robert Jubelirer said the bill would not be approved in the Senate, according to the newspaper.
